claim_text: The frozen public AFINO baseline can reproduce the five published TESS detections used in F0.
allowed_wording: The frozen public AFINO baseline reproduced the five published TESS detections in the F0 reproduction cohort.
mandatory_qualification: Scope to the frozen F0 cohort; paper-code identity remains unresolved.
prohibited_wording: AFINO is observationally validated or the five detections are physically proven.

claim_text: F1 synthetic performance is strongly dependent on the simulated domain, including duration/sampling and signal properties.
allowed_wording: Synthetic benchmark behavior varies materially across the frozen duration/sampling and signal-property domain.
mandatory_qualification: Keep the designed synthetic domain explicit.
prohibited_wording: This performance directly describes the real TESS population.

claim_text: F1 numerical diagnostics show multiple numerical solutions/warnings/bounds without corresponding binary-decision instability in the examined scope.
allowed_wording: Numerical multiplicity and diagnostics coexist with binary-decision stability in the examined frozen F1 scopes.
mandatory_qualification: Do not infer a unique global optimum or auditable convergence.
prohibited_wording: The optimizer has a unique global solution.

claim_text: The F2 pilot shows classification sensitivity to prospectively defined methodological perturbations.
allowed_wording: The F2 observational pilot shows that frozen methodological perturbations can change reference classifications.
mandatory_qualification: Observational reference labels are not physical ground truth.
prohibited_wording: F2 estimates observational sensitivity or false-negative rate.

claim_text: F3A extends that robustness experiment to a 122-event observational catalogue-scale cohort.
allowed_wording: F3A extends the prospectively frozen robustness stress test to 122 observational reference events.
mandatory_qualification: Do not pool F2 and F3A denominators.
prohibited_wording: F3A is a validation dataset with physical labels.

claim_text: F3A reveals a material baseline-reproduction limitation: 51/61 published QPP references mismatch the frozen W00/P00 baseline.
allowed_wording: Under the frozen F3A W00/P00/seed0 baseline, 51 of 61 published-QPP references are baseline mismatches.
mandatory_qualification: Cause remains UNRESOLVED_WITHIN_F3A.
prohibited_wording: 51 published QPPs are false detections.

claim_text: Those 51 mismatches are not evidence that 51 published QPPs are physically false.
allowed_wording: The 51 F3A baseline mismatches are reproduction mismatches, not physical falsifications.
mandatory_qualification: Observational labels are reference states, not physical truth.
prohibited_wording: 51 published QPPs are physically false.

claim_text: Among baseline-concordant F3A references, methodological perturbations produce retained and lost QPP selections.
allowed_wording: Among baseline-concordant QPP references, F3A contains both retained selections and selection losses under frozen perturbations.
mandatory_qualification: Condition on the baseline-concordant transition-eligible scope.
prohibited_wording: These are observational true positives and false negatives.

claim_text: No selection gains occurred in the relevant baseline-concordant not-selected F3A scope.
allowed_wording: No baseline-relative selection gains were observed in the relevant baseline-concordant not-selected reference scope.
mandatory_qualification: Repeated perturbations of observational references are not independent known negatives.
prohibited_wording: Observational FPR is zero.

claim_text: M1C009 is not an observational FPR estimate.
allowed_wording: The absence of F3A selection gains is a robustness result, not an observational FPR estimate.
mandatory_qualification: Keep evidence-plane semantics explicit.
prohibited_wording: F3A establishes observational specificity or FPR.

claim_text: Binary classification is seed-stable in the frozen F3A stability scope despite numerical multiplicity.
allowed_wording: All 116 input-eligible F3A W00/P00 events preserve binary classification across the frozen seed grid.
mandatory_qualification: Stable classification does not imply unique optimizer convergence.
prohibited_wording: The optimizer converges uniquely.

claim_text: F3B provides known synthetic-ground-truth characterization in the preregistered domain.
allowed_wording: F3B provides DEVELOPMENT and independent single-use HELDOUT synthetic-ground-truth characterization within the frozen domain.
mandatory_qualification: Synthetic truth is not observational truth.
prohibited_wording: F3B observationally validates AFINO.

claim_text: DEVELOPMENT and independent HELDOUT show a low-sensitivity, extremely-high-specificity operating profile for the frozen 10/10 baseline.
allowed_wording: DEVELOPMENT and HELDOUT separately show a low-sensitivity, extremely-high-specificity synthetic-domain operating profile for the frozen 10/10 baseline.
mandatory_qualification: Descriptive split comparison only; no pooling or equivalence test.
prohibited_wording: DEVELOPMENT and HELDOUT are statistically equivalent.

claim_text: HELDOUT sensitivity is 152/1800 in the frozen synthetic domain.
allowed_wording: HELDOUT synthetic sensitivity is 152/1800 in the frozen Phase 3B domain.
mandatory_qualification: Always state synthetic HELDOUT scope and denominator.
prohibited_wording: Observational sensitivity is 8.44%.

claim_text: Zero false selections were observed among 1800 HELDOUT synthetic nulls, with finite Wilson uncertainty.
allowed_wording: No false selections were observed among 1800 HELDOUT synthetic nulls; finite-sample Wilson uncertainty remains.
mandatory_qualification: Do not call specificity perfect or population FPR zero.
prohibited_wording: AFINO has zero false-positive rate in the population.

claim_text: Observed FP=0 does not imply a population FPR of zero.
allowed_wording: The observed 0/1800 HELDOUT false-selection count does not establish an underlying population FPR of zero.
mandatory_qualification: Retain Wilson uncertainty and synthetic-domain scope.
prohibited_wording: Population FPR is exactly zero.

claim_text: The DEVELOPMENT two-threshold candidate was not promoted because it failed the preregistered specificity-preservation gate.
allowed_wording: The DEVELOPMENT candidate failed the preregistered specificity-preservation criterion and was not promoted.
mandatory_qualification: No runner-up rescue or post-hoc alternate search.
prohibited_wording: The candidate was rejected because of HELDOUT results.

claim_text: The final held-out rule therefore remained the untuned AFINO 0.5 10/10 baseline.
allowed_wording: The HELDOUT target remained the frozen AFINO 0.5 rule delta_BIC01>10 and delta_BIC21>10.
mandatory_qualification: Strict greater-than; frozen before HELDOUT truth.
prohibited_wording: HELDOUT was used to tune thresholds.

claim_text: The HELDOUT stratified empirical selection function is characterized within the frozen synthetic domain.
allowed_wording: The final 156-row HELDOUT stratified empirical selection surface characterizes the frozen synthetic domain.
mandatory_qualification: No DEVELOPMENT pooling, smoothing, or observational transport.
prohibited_wording: This is a universal TESS selection function.

claim_text: That synthetic selection function is not an observational population correction.
allowed_wording: The F3B selection surface is synthetic-domain evidence and is not an observational population correction.
mandatory_qualification: Population transport remains a separate future problem.
prohibited_wording: Apply it directly as the TESS population correction.

claim_text: Period accuracy is comparatively good conditional on selected true positives, while selection coverage is low.
allowed_wording: Period-recovery accuracy is summarized conditional on selected true positives, while overall positive selection coverage is low.
mandatory_qualification: Keep conditioning on selection explicit.
prohibited_wording: Good period accuracy means high completeness.

claim_text: Conditional period accuracy does not imply high detection completeness.
allowed_wording: Accurate periods among selected true positives can coexist with low selection sensitivity.
mandatory_qualification: Separate period recovery from classifier sensitivity.
prohibited_wording: Period accuracy proves detection completeness.

claim_text: A validated correction was not established.
allowed_wording: Phase 3B closed with correction claim NOT_ESTABLISHED.
mandatory_qualification: Do not weaken or silently omit this boundary.
prohibited_wording: A validated observational correction was established.

claim_text: AFINO has not been observationally validated by the present programme.
allowed_wording: The programme provides distinct reproduction, robustness and synthetic-ground-truth evidence, but not observational validation of AFINO.
mandatory_qualification: Keep the evidence planes separate.
prohibited_wording: AFINO is observationally validated.

claim_text: Population transport/correction remains an F4+ problem.
allowed_wording: Population transport and observational correction remain future work beyond the present manuscript evidence freeze.
mandatory_qualification: Requires explicit transport assumptions and independent later evidence.
prohibited_wording: The synthetic selection function is already a validated population correction.

claim_text: AFINO is observationally validated by F0–F3B.
allowed_wording: Do not make this claim.
mandatory_qualification: The programme contains no observational physical-ground-truth validation plane.
prohibited_wording: AFINO is observationally validated.

claim_text: The F3B synthetic selection function is a validated observational population correction.
allowed_wording: Do not make this claim.
mandatory_qualification: Synthetic-domain selection cannot be transported without additional assumptions/evidence.
prohibited_wording: The F3B selection function is the validated TESS correction.

claim_text: Priority and novelty language must remain bounded by BAII; catalogue scale, TESS use, QPP classification and injection-recovery each have relevant precedence.
allowed_wording: Position the contribution in terms of the combined prospective robustness and heldout architecture rather than unqualified first-ever claims.
mandatory_qualification: BAII is bounded to its frozen search/extraction scope and is not a global novelty proof.
prohibited_wording: first catalogue-scale TESS QPP study; first TESS QPP catalogue; first QPP injection-recovery study

claim_text: The five evidence classes must not be collapsed under an unqualified generic use of the word validation.
allowed_wording: Name the evidence plane when describing reproduction, robustness, numerical benchmarking, or heldout synthetic performance.
mandatory_qualification: Different planes have different truth conditions and denominators.
prohibited_wording: All phases independently validate AFINO in the same sense.
